notes:
Nocto 0.8.0: Twitch plugin, Plugin SDK 2 and the plugin library
- New in-app plugin library (File > Plugins): install a plugin from a .zip with a file list and confirmation, or browse and install from the plugin list with a checksum check
- Twitch plugin (separate download): sign in with a device code, edit stream title, category and tags, and a chat dock
- Plugin SDK 1.1 (ABI 2): plugin docks and panels, menus, settings, secret storage, HTTPS and WebSocket; existing plugins keep working
- Windows x64, Windows ARM64 and Linux x86_64 builds; Linux includes the 0.7.1 to 0.7.3 changes

linux-x64.label: Linux
linux-x64.requirements: Linux x86_64 (Wayland or X11, PipeWire, Mesa 24+ or NVIDIA driver)
linux-x64.install:
Install: download the AppImage, then run chmod +x Nocto-0.8.0-x86_64.AppImage and start it with ./Nocto-0.8.0-x86_64.AppImage.

Needs: a Wayland or X11 desktop with PipeWire and xdg-desktop-portal, and your distribution's GPU drivers (Mesa 24+ for Intel/AMD, or the NVIDIA proprietary driver). Recommended: GStreamer plugins-base and plugins-good for browser source audio; the v4l2loopback camera driver for the virtual camera in Discord/Zoom (Nocto offers a one-click setup with your desktop's password dialog, no terminal needed). Updates install from inside Nocto (checksum verified, with automatic rollback); if you are on 0.7.2 or older, download this one manually once.
